access.fees: None — no climbing fee (National Forest wilderness, not Mount Rainier NP)
access.notes: Climbable roughly June–October; heavy winter snowfall and frequent avalanche control closures on I-90 affect access the rest of the year.
access.rules: Standard USFS wilderness group-size limit of 12 people (combined with stock) per party where the peak is inside Alpine Lakes Wilderness.
access.permit: Self-issued Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit at the trailhead, available May 15–Oct 31
access.closures: Foss River Road (FR 68) has experienced upper-road damage limiting access and is subject to seasonal washouts plus posted weekday construction delays (~30 min, May-Sept); check current Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie NF alerts before driving.
access.landManager: Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest, Skykomish Ranger District (Alpine Lakes Wilderness)
access.land_manager: Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest (Skykomish Ranger District)
access.parking_pass: Northwest Forest Pass ($30/yr) or America the Beautiful pass, or a $5/day pass at developed trailheads.

overnight_permit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
overnight_permit.where: Fill one out at the trailhead kiosk and carry your copy.
